```{r, setup}
# §4.13g — quantitative sanity gate on the full feature matrix: does cell-type
# identity (ontology) dominate, as expected (fingerprint confound); does a
# technical factor -- protocol, imputation status, or cohort/project (batch) --
# dominate any PC (would indicate an artefact rather than biology)?
#
# GATES (append_sanity() -> qc/sanity_summary.csv; WARN, not stopifnot) run per
# (Event Type × transcript_filter) stratum -- matching what 09-1-ml-local.R
# models at. The confound question is tested UNBIASED via PC1-dominance:
#   - pca_{protocol,project,imputation}_dominance : PC1 not driven by a confound
#     (protocol/imputation via |cor|; multi-level project via eta^2)
# Group silhouettes (ontology/protocol/project/imputed) are logged INFO only
# (pca_silhouette_*) -- NOT gated relative to each other: silhouette is biased
# toward few/large clusters, so a ~40-level ontology would always lose a race to
# 2-level protocol regardless of biology. PC1-dominance is the unbiased test.
#
# GALLERY (feature-gallery chunk; plots only, not gates) is folded in from the
# now-deprecated 05z-visualize-features.Rmd: PCA/UMAP per (Event Type ×
# transcript_filter × Variability incl. "Both"), colored by ontology(palette)/
# project/protocol/PSI/chromosome, plus top PC1/PC2 feature loadings.
#
# PSI (target) EMBEDDING (psi-embedding chunk): (A) samples in PSI-space
# (pairwise-cor -> PCoA) with UNBIASED protocol |cor| / project eta^2 dominance
# gates (RI protocol dominance expected -> INFO); (B) events in PSI-space.
#
# Shared standardized-PCA/UMAP machinery: 05zz-feature-preprocessing.R's
# preprocess_feature_matrix(mode="embedding").
library(cluster)
library(uwot)
library(rsvd)
library(patchwork)
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanity_csv <- "qc/sanity_summary.csv"
append_sanity <- function(check_name, status, value, threshold, notes = "") {
  new_row <- data.table(
    check_name = check_name,
    status = status,
    value = value,
    threshold = threshold,
    notes = notes
  )
  if (file.exists(sanity_csv)) {
    # upsert by check_name: drop any prior row for this check before writing
    # the new one, so sanity_summary.csv doesn't accumulate stale/duplicate
    # rows across reruns (append=TRUE never truncated -> the file only grew).
    existing <- fread(sanity_csv)
    existing <- existing[check_name != new_row$check_name]
    fwrite(rbind(existing, new_row, fill = TRUE), sanity_csv)
  } else {
    fwrite(new_row, sanity_csv)
  }
}

source("05zz-feature-preprocessing.R")
# Per-filter (matches 02-2 .. 05): one transcript_filter per invocation, chosen
# by the TRANSCRIPT_FILTER env var (Snakemake would set it; standalone falls back
# to the primary filter). The combined pre-per-filter file no longer exists.
tf <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  unset = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)
aggregated_dt <- fread(sprintf(
  "processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered_%s.csv.gz",
  tf
))

meta_cols <- c(
  "ID",
  "IHEC",
  "uuid",
  "transcript_filter",
  "PSI",
  "Event Type",
  "gene_id",
  "seqnames",
  "Variability",
  "ontology",
  "project",
  "protocol"
)
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(aggregated_dt), meta_cols)

# §4.13l's per-mark H3K*_source columns (observed/imputed) may not exist yet
# if aggregated_dt_filtered_{tf}.csv.gz predates that change -- degrade gracefully
# rather than error, and record that item 4 was skipped.
source_cols <- grep("_source$", names(aggregated_dt), value = TRUE)
has_imputed_info <- length(source_cols) > 0
if (!has_imputed_info) {
  message(
    "No *_source columns found in aggregated_dt -- imputation-dominance ",
    "check (item 4) will be skipped. Re-run 05-create-aggregated-dt.Rmd ",
    "(§4.13l) and rebuild aggregated_dt_filtered_{tf}.csv.gz to enable it."
  )
}

strata <- unique(aggregated_dt[, .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)])
setorder(strata, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)

N_PCS <- 30
DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET <- 100000L
SIL_SAMPLE_N <- 3000L # silhouette is O(n^2) in memory/time; subsample further
UMAP_NEIGHBORS <- 30
UMAP_MIN_DIST <- 0.05
UMAP_METRIC <- "cosine"

# --- gallery constants (folded in from the deprecated 05z-visualize-features) --
TOP_LOADINGS <- 20
COMBINED_VARIABILITY_LABEL <- "Both"
DOWNSAMPLE_SEED <- 123L
DOWNSAMPLE_STRATA <- c("ontology", "project", "protocol")

# deterministic per-combo seed so a given stratum always downsamples the same way
combo_seed <- function(...) {
  combo_txt <- paste(..., collapse = "|")
  as.integer(
    (sum(utf8ToInt(combo_txt)) + DOWNSAMPLE_SEED) %% .Machine$integer.max
  )
}

# correlation ratio eta^2 of a continuous y across a categorical g (0..1):
# the multi-level analogue of |cor| used for the 2-level protocol check, so
# `project` (many cohorts) can be tested for PC1 dominance the same way.
eta_sq <- function(y, g) {
  g <- factor(g)
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(g)
  y <- y[ok]
  g <- droplevels(g[ok])
  if (nlevels(g) < 2L || length(y) < 2L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  grand <- mean(y)
  ss_tot <- sum((y - grand)^2)
  if (ss_tot == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  ss_between <- sum(tapply(y, g, function(v) length(v) * (mean(v) - grand)^2))
  ss_between / ss_tot
}
```


```{r, per-stratum-pca-checks, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
run_stratum <- function(this_et, this_tf) {
  stratum_key <- paste(this_et, this_tf, sep = "_")
  sub_dt <- aggregated_dt[
    `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf
  ]

  if (nrow(sub_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
    set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))
    sub_dt <- sub_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
  }

  preprocessed <- preprocess_feature_matrix(
    feat_mat = as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..feature_cols]),
    histone_marks = histone_marks,
    mode = "embedding",
    drop_sparse = FALSE
  )
  feat_mat <- preprocessed$feat_mat
  if (ncol(feat_mat) < 2) {
    message(stratum_key, ": < 2 usable feature columns, skipping")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # --- PCA (randomized SVD on standardized features) ------------------------
  k <- min(N_PCS, nrow(feat_mat) - 1L, ncol(feat_mat))
  pca_res <- rsvd(feat_mat, k = k)
  var_pct <- pca_res$d^2 / sum(pca_res$d^2) * 100
  pc_scores <- sweep(pca_res$u, 2, pca_res$d, `*`)

  cum_var5 <- sum(var_pct[seq_len(min(5, length(var_pct)))])
  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_cumulative_variance_pc1_5_", stratum_key),
    "PASS", # informational, not a gate
    cum_var5,
    NA,
    sprintf(
      "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, cumulative PC1-5=%.1f%%",
      stratum_key,
      var_pct[1],
      cum_var5
    )
  )

  # --- item 3: protocol should not dominate PC1 ------------------------------
  # protocol has exactly 2 levels (mRNA-Seq/total-RNA-Seq) -- operationalize
  # "PC1 loads protocol with |loading| > 0.5" as |cor(PC1 score, protocol)|,
  # since protocol itself isn't a PCA input feature (it's metadata used only
  # for coloring/grouping), a literal PCA loading doesn't exist for it.
  protocol_num <- as.integer(factor(sub_dt$protocol))
  protocol_cor_pc1 <- suppressWarnings(cor(
    pc_scores[, 1],
    protocol_num,
    use = "complete.obs"
  ))
  protocol_dominates <- var_pct[1] > 50 & abs(protocol_cor_pc1) > 0.5
  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_protocol_dominance_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(!protocol_dominates, "PASS", "WARN"),
    protocol_cor_pc1,
    0.5,
    sprintf(
      "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, |cor(PC1, protocol)|=%.3f (flag if PC1>50%% var AND |cor|>0.5)",
      stratum_key,
      var_pct[1],
      abs(protocol_cor_pc1)
    )
  )

  # --- item 3b: project/cohort (batch) should not dominate PC1 ---------------
  # `project` is multi-level (BLUEPRINT/DEEP/AMED-CREST/...), so use eta^2
  # (correlation ratio) instead of the 2-level |cor| used for protocol. A large
  # eta^2 on a high-variance PC1 would indicate a cohort batch effect driving
  # the feature matrix rather than biology.
  project_eta_pc1 <- eta_sq(pc_scores[, 1], sub_dt$project)
  project_dominates <- isTRUE(var_pct[1] > 50 & project_eta_pc1 > 0.5)
  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_project_dominance_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(!project_dominates, "PASS", "WARN"),
    project_eta_pc1,
    0.5,
    sprintf(
      "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, eta^2(PC1 ~ project)=%.3f (flag if PC1>50%% var AND eta^2>0.5)",
      stratum_key,
      var_pct[1],
      ifelse(is.na(project_eta_pc1), NA_real_, project_eta_pc1)
    )
  )

  # --- item 4: imputed vs observed samples should not separate ---------------
  imputed_any <- NULL
  if (has_imputed_info) {
    source_mat <- as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..source_cols])
    imputed_any <- as.integer(apply(
      source_mat == "imputed",
      1,
      any,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ))
    if (length(unique(imputed_any)) > 1) {
      imputed_cor_pc1 <- suppressWarnings(cor(
        pc_scores[, 1],
        imputed_any,
        use = "complete.obs"
      ))
      imputed_dominates <- var_pct[1] > 50 & abs(imputed_cor_pc1) > 0.5
      append_sanity(
        paste0("pca_imputation_dominance_", stratum_key),
        ifelse(!imputed_dominates, "PASS", "WARN"),
        imputed_cor_pc1,
        0.5,
        sprintf(
          "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, |cor(PC1, imputed_any)|=%.3f (flag if PC1>50%% var AND |cor|>0.5)",
          stratum_key,
          var_pct[1],
          abs(imputed_cor_pc1)
        )
      )
    } else {
      append_sanity(
        paste0("pca_imputation_dominance_", stratum_key),
        "PASS",
        NA,
        0.5,
        sprintf(
          "%s: all sampled rows have the same imputed/observed status, nothing to compare",
          stratum_key
        )
      )
    }
  }

  # --- item 5: silhouette by group, on a further subsample (dist() is O(n^2)) -
  sil_idx <- if (nrow(pc_scores) > SIL_SAMPLE_N) {
    sample(nrow(pc_scores), SIL_SAMPLE_N)
  } else {
    seq_len(nrow(pc_scores))
  }
  sil_pcs <- pc_scores[sil_idx, seq_len(min(10, ncol(pc_scores))), drop = FALSE]
  sil_dist <- dist(sil_pcs)

  mean_silhouette <- function(grouping) {
    grouping <- grouping[sil_idx]
    if (length(unique(grouping)) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    mean(cluster::silhouette(as.integer(factor(grouping)), sil_dist)[,
      "sil_width"
    ])
  }

  sil_ontology <- mean_silhouette(sub_dt$ontology)
  sil_protocol <- mean_silhouette(sub_dt$protocol)
  sil_project <- mean_silhouette(sub_dt$project)
  sil_imputed <- if (has_imputed_info) {
    mean_silhouette(imputed_any)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_silhouette_", stratum_key),
    "PASS", # informational -- reports which variable best explains PC separation, not a gate
    NA,
    NA,
    sprintf(
      "%s: mean silhouette (first 10 PCs, n=%d) -- ontology=%.3f, protocol=%.3f, project=%.3f, imputed=%s",
      stratum_key,
      length(sil_idx),
      sil_ontology,
      sil_protocol,
      sil_project,
      ifelse(is.na(sil_imputed), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", sil_imputed))
    )
  )

  # NB: intentionally NO ontology-vs-confound silhouette GATE. Silhouette is
  # biased toward few/large clusters, so a ~40-level `ontology` grouping
  # systematically loses to 2-level `protocol`/`imputed` regardless of biology
  # (ontology silhouette goes ~0/negative from cluster count alone) -- a relative
  # comparison here is rigged to fail. The real "is a confound driving the
  # embedding?" question is answered UNBIASED by the PC1-dominance checks above
  # (protocol/imputation |cor|, project eta^2). Silhouettes stay INFO only.

  # Rich visualization (colorings + PC loadings, per-Variability) is produced by
  # the gallery chunk below; the gates here are stratified only by Event Type ×
  # filter (matching what 09-1 models at).
  invisible(NULL)
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
  run_stratum(strata$`Event Type`[i], strata$transcript_filter[i])
}
```


```{r, feature-gallery, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
# Exploratory PCA/UMAP gallery folded in from the deprecated
# 05z-visualize-features.Rmd. Unlike the sanity gates above, this runs per
# (Event Type × transcript_filter × Variability) INCLUDING a combined "Both",
# and shows richer colorings (ontology[palette]/project/protocol/PSI/chromosome)
# plus the top PC1/PC2 feature LOADINGS. Plots saved to
# plot_dir/feature_umap_pca/{ET}_{tf}_{var}.{pdf,png}; not a pass/fail gate.
dir.create(
  file.path(plot_dir, "feature_umap_pca"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

run_gallery <- function(
  this_et,
  this_tf,
  this_variability,
  print_plot = FALSE
) {
  if (identical(this_variability, COMBINED_VARIABILITY_LABEL)) {
    sub_dt <- aggregated_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_tf & `Event Type` == this_et
    ]
  } else {
    sub_dt <- aggregated_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_tf &
        `Event Type` == this_et &
        Variability == this_variability
    ]
  }
  if (nrow(sub_dt) < 10) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # stratified downsample of very large groups (composition-preserving)
  if (nrow(sub_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
    set.seed(combo_seed(this_tf, this_et, this_variability))
    strata_cols <- intersect(DOWNSAMPLE_STRATA, names(sub_dt))
    if (length(strata_cols) > 0L) {
      sub_dt[, row_idx__ := .I]
      sample_frac <- DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET / nrow(sub_dt)
      sampled_dt <- sub_dt[,
        {
          take_n <- min(.N, max(1L, as.integer(round(.N * sample_frac))))
          .SD[sample(.N, take_n)]
        },
        by = strata_cols
      ]
      if (nrow(sampled_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
        sampled_dt <- sampled_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
      } else if (nrow(sampled_dt) < DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
        remainder <- sub_dt[!sampled_dt, on = "row_idx__"]
        if (nrow(remainder) > 0L) {
          sampled_dt <- rbind(
            sampled_dt,
            remainder[sample(
              .N,
              min(DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET - nrow(sampled_dt), .N)
            )],
            use.names = TRUE
          )
        }
      }
      sub_dt <- sampled_dt[, !"row_idx__", with = FALSE]
    } else {
      sub_dt <- sub_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
    }
  }

  preprocessed <- preprocess_feature_matrix(
    feat_mat = as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..feature_cols]),
    histone_marks = histone_marks,
    mode = "embedding",
    drop_sparse = FALSE
  )
  feat_mat <- preprocessed$feat_mat
  if (ncol(feat_mat) < 2) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  title_str <- paste(this_et, this_tf, this_variability, sep = " | ")

  k <- min(N_PCS, nrow(feat_mat) - 1L, ncol(feat_mat))
  pca_res <- rsvd(feat_mat, k = k)
  var_pct <- pca_res$d^2 / sum(pca_res$d^2) * 100
  pca_df <- data.table(
    PC1 = pca_res$u[, 1] * pca_res$d[1],
    PC2 = pca_res$u[, 2] * pca_res$d[2],
    ontology = sub_dt$ontology,
    project = sub_dt$project,
    protocol = sub_dt$protocol,
    psi = sub_dt$PSI,
    chr = sub_dt$seqnames
  )
  load_df <- data.table(
    feature = colnames(feat_mat),
    PC1 = pca_res$v[, 1],
    PC2 = pca_res$v[, 2]
  )

  legend_theme <- theme(
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7)
  )
  plot_loadings <- function(pc) {
    top <- load_df[order(-abs(get(pc)))][seq_len(min(TOP_LOADINGS, .N))]
    top[, feature := factor(feature, levels = feature[order(get(pc))])]
    ggplot(top, aes(x = .data[[pc]], y = feature, fill = .data[[pc]] > 0)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2166ac", `FALSE` = "#d6604d")) +
      labs(
        x = sprintf("%s loading", pc),
        y = NULL,
        title = sprintf(
          "Top %d %s loadings (%.1f%% var)",
          TOP_LOADINGS,
          pc,
          var_pct[as.integer(sub("PC", "", pc))]
        )
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9)
  }

  umap_res <- uwot::umap(
    feat_mat,
    n_neighbors = UMAP_NEIGHBORS,
    min_dist = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
    metric = UMAP_METRIC,
    n_threads = 2L,
    seed = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L)
  )
  umap_df <- data.table(
    U1 = umap_res[, 1],
    U2 = umap_res[, 2],
    ontology = sub_dt$ontology,
    project = sub_dt$project,
    protocol = sub_dt$protocol,
    psi = sub_dt$PSI,
    chr = sub_dt$seqnames
  )

  make_embed <- function(df, x, y, col, xlab, ylab) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
      labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = col) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
      legend_theme
    if (col == "ontology" && !is.null(sample_hex_colors)) {
      p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = sample_hex_colors)
    }
    p
  }
  make_paired_plot <- function(col) {
    (make_embed(
      pca_df,
      "PC1",
      "PC2",
      col,
      sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[1]),
      sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[2])
    ) +
      make_embed(umap_df, "U1", "U2", col, "UMAP 1", "UMAP 2") +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect")) &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }

  fig_loadings <- plot_loadings("PC1") | plot_loadings("PC2")
  fig <- ((make_paired_plot("psi") | fig_loadings) /
    (make_paired_plot("project") | make_paired_plot("protocol")) /
    (make_paired_plot("chr") | make_paired_plot("ontology"))) +
    plot_annotation(title = title_str)
  if (print_plot) {
    print(fig)
  }

  for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        "feature_umap_pca",
        sprintf("%s_%s_%s.%s", this_et, this_tf, this_variability, ext)
      ),
      plot = fig,
      height = 210,
      width = 297,
      units = "mm"
    )
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

gallery_combos <- CJ(
  event_type = unique(strata$`Event Type`),
  variability = c(
    as.character(aggregated_dt[, unique(Variability)]),
    COMBINED_VARIABILITY_LABEL
  ),
  sorted = FALSE
)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(gallery_combos))) {
  run_gallery(
    gallery_combos$event_type[i],
    tf,
    gallery_combos$variability[i],
    print_plot = TRUE
  )
}
```


```{r, psi-embedding, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Embed the TARGET (PSI) itself — complementary to the epigenetic-feature
# embedding above. Per (Event Type × transcript_filter). PSI is heavily missing
# (expr_pass masking + tissue-specific non-expression), handled per view.
#   (A) SAMPLES in PSI-space: does the splicing landscape separate samples by
#       biology (ontology) or a confound (protocol/project)? Target-side analogue
#       of the feature fingerprint. NA-native via pairwise-complete correlation
#       → PCoA (cmdscale) + a silhouette gate. NB for RI, protocol separation is
#       the EXPECTED documented bias (total-RNA inflates RI Ψ ~0.05), so an RI
#       protocol > ontology result is informational, not a true artefact.
#   (B) EVENTS in PSI-space: co-regulation structure (which events co-vary).
#       Event×event pairwise-cor is too large (~event² ) → coverage-filter
#       (event present in ≥50% samples) + per-event mean-impute, then PCA/UMAP.
dir.create(
  file.path(plot_dir, "psi_embedding"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
SEED <- getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L)

sil_by <- function(grp, d) {
  grp <- factor(grp)
  if (nlevels(grp) < 2L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(cluster::silhouette(as.integer(grp), d)[, "sil_width"])
}

run_psi_embedding <- function(this_et, this_tf) {
  key <- paste(this_et, this_tf, sep = "_")
  sub <- aggregated_dt[
    `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf,
    .(ID, uuid, PSI, ontology, protocol, project, Variability, seqnames)
  ]
  psi_wide <- dcast(sub, ID ~ uuid, value.var = "PSI")
  m <- as.matrix(psi_wide[, -1L]) # events × samples
  rownames(m) <- psi_wide$ID
  if (nrow(m) < 10L || ncol(m) < 4L) {
    message(key, ": PSI matrix too small, skipping")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  smeta <- unique(sub[, .(uuid, ontology, protocol, project)])
  setkey(smeta, uuid)
  smeta <- smeta[colnames(m)]

  # focus on well-covered events (≥50% samples) — sparse events add noise and
  # slow the pairwise correlation
  cover <- rowMeans(!is.na(m))
  m_cov <- m[cover >= 0.5, , drop = FALSE]

  # --- (A) SAMPLES in PSI-space --------------------------------------------
  if (nrow(m_cov) >= 10L) {
    samp_cor <- cor(m_cov, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    samp_cor[is.na(samp_cor)] <- 0
    samp_dist <- as.dist(1 - samp_cor)
    mds <- cmdscale(samp_dist, k = 2)
    sdf <- data.table(
      MDS1 = mds[, 1],
      MDS2 = mds[, 2],
      ontology = smeta$ontology,
      protocol = smeta$protocol,
      project = smeta$project
    )

    # UNBIASED confound checks on PCoA1 (mirror the feature-space PC1-dominance
    # gates; avoid silhouette's cluster-count bias — a ~40-level ontology would
    # always lose a silhouette race to 2-level protocol regardless of biology).
    # protocol is 2-level -> |cor|; project is multi-level -> eta^2. For RI,
    # protocol dominating the PSI landscape is the EXPECTED documented bias
    # (total-RNA inflates RI Ψ ~0.05) -> INFO, not WARN.
    mds1 <- mds[, 1]
    prot_num <- as.integer(factor(smeta$protocol))
    psi_prot_cor <- if (length(unique(na.omit(prot_num))) > 1L) {
      abs(suppressWarnings(cor(mds1, prot_num, use = "complete.obs")))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    psi_proj_eta <- eta_sq(mds1, smeta$project)

    append_sanity(
      paste0("psi_sample_protocol_dominance_", key),
      if (this_et == "RI") "INFO" else if (isTRUE(psi_prot_cor > 0.5)) "WARN" else "PASS",
      psi_prot_cor,
      0.5,
      sprintf(
        "%s: |cor(PCoA1, protocol)|=%.3f over %d well-covered events%s",
        key,
        ifelse(is.na(psi_prot_cor), NA_real_, psi_prot_cor),
        nrow(m_cov),
        if (this_et == "RI") " [RI protocol bias expected -> INFO]" else " (flag > 0.5)"
      )
    )
    append_sanity(
      paste0("psi_sample_project_dominance_", key),
      if (isTRUE(psi_proj_eta > 0.5)) "WARN" else "PASS",
      psi_proj_eta,
      0.5,
      sprintf(
        "%s: eta^2(PCoA1 ~ project)=%.3f (flag > 0.5 = cohort batch drives PSI landscape)",
        key,
        ifelse(is.na(psi_proj_eta), NA_real_, psi_proj_eta)
      )
    )
    # ontology silhouette kept as INFO context only (cluster-count-biased; not a gate)
    append_sanity(
      paste0("psi_sample_ontology_silhouette_", key),
      "INFO",
      sil_by(smeta$ontology, samp_dist),
      NA_real_,
      sprintf(
        "%s: PSI-space ontology silhouette (INFO; biased by #levels, not a gate)",
        key
      )
    )

    mk_a <- function(col) {
      p <- ggplot(sdf, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = .data[[col]])) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
        labs(
          title = paste("samples in PSI-space:", col),
          x = "PCoA1",
          y = "PCoA2",
          color = col
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
        theme(
          legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
        )
      if (col == "ontology" && !is.null(sample_hex_colors)) {
        p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = sample_hex_colors)
      }
      p
    }
    fig_a <- (mk_a("ontology") | mk_a("protocol") | mk_a("project")) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = sprintf("%s — samples embedded by PSI profile", key)
      )
    print(fig_a)
    ggsave(
      file.path(plot_dir, "psi_embedding", sprintf("psi_samples_%s.pdf", key)),
      plot = fig_a,
      width = 12,
      height = 4.5
    )
  }

  # --- (B) EVENTS in PSI-space ---------------------------------------------
  if (nrow(m_cov) >= 10L) {
    m_ev <- m_cov
    if (nrow(m_ev) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
      set.seed(SEED)
      m_ev <- m_ev[sample(nrow(m_ev), DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    rmean <- rowMeans(m_ev, na.rm = TRUE)
    na_idx <- which(is.na(m_ev), arr.ind = TRUE)
    if (nrow(na_idx)) {
      m_ev[na_idx] <- rmean[na_idx[, 1L]]
    }
    ev_meta <- unique(sub[, .(ID, Variability, seqnames)])
    setkey(ev_meta, ID)
    ev_meta <- ev_meta[as.integer(rownames(m_ev))]

    k <- min(N_PCS, nrow(m_ev) - 1L, ncol(m_ev))
    pev <- rsvd(m_ev, k = k)
    vp <- pev$d^2 / sum(pev$d^2) * 100
    ev_scores <- sweep(pev$u, 2, pev$d, `*`)
    ue <- uwot::umap(
      m_ev,
      n_neighbors = UMAP_NEIGHBORS,
      min_dist = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
      metric = UMAP_METRIC,
      n_threads = 2L,
      seed = SEED
    )
    edf <- data.table(
      PC1 = ev_scores[, 1],
      PC2 = ev_scores[, 2],
      U1 = ue[, 1],
      U2 = ue[, 2],
      Variability = ev_meta$Variability,
      seqnames = ev_meta$seqnames,
      mean_psi = rmean[rownames(m_ev)]
    )
    mk_b <- function(x, y, col, xl, yl) {
      ggplot(edf, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], color = .data[[col]])) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
        labs(title = col, x = xl, y = yl, color = col) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
        theme(
          legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
        )
    }
    fig_b <- ((mk_b(
      "PC1",
      "PC2",
      "Variability",
      sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", vp[1]),
      sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", vp[2])
    ) |
      mk_b(
        "PC1",
        "PC2",
        "mean_psi",
        sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", vp[1]),
        sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", vp[2])
      )) /
      (mk_b("U1", "U2", "Variability", "UMAP1", "UMAP2") |
        mk_b("U1", "U2", "mean_psi", "UMAP1", "UMAP2"))) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = sprintf(
          "%s — events embedded by PSI profile (n=%d, cover≥50%%)",
          key,
          nrow(m_ev)
        )
      )
    print(fig_b)
    ggsave(
      file.path(plot_dir, "psi_embedding", sprintf("psi_events_%s.pdf", key)),
      plot = fig_b,
      width = 11,
      height = 8
    )
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
  run_psi_embedding(strata$`Event Type`[i], strata$transcript_filter[i])
}
```
